sections.title: Information We Collect
items: Personal information you provide when creating an account
Transaction details when you make a purchase
Communication data when you contact us for support
Usage information about how you interact with our services

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Process transactions and send related information
Communicate with you about updates and support
Analyze usage patterns to enhance user experience
Comply with legal obligations and protect our rights

sections.title: Information Sharing
items: We do not sell your personal information to third parties
We may share data with service providers who assist our operations
We may disclose information when required by law
We may share data in connection with business transfers

sections.title: Data Security
items: We implement industry-standard encryption protocols
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
Access controls and authentication measures
Secure data storage and transmission practices
Employee training on data protection procedures

sections.title: Contact Us
items: Email us at privacy@launchpad.com for privacy-related questions
Contact our support team for general inquiries
Submit requests for data access or deletion
